brand.name: GoodWe
brand.notes: Chinese maker of on-grid, hybrid and storage inverters plus batteries and BMS. Pakistan is an official GoodWe market with a dedicated en.goodwe.com/pakistan portal, warehouses in Rawalpindi and Lahore and service hubs in Karachi and Lahore; the SDT G3 8-30kW three-phase hybrid is one of the lines actively marketed there.
